name: MessageActionCard
description: The card is a disclosure: open by default, and a consumer can fold a resolved or view-only card to its header with `defaultOpen={false}` (or control it with `open` / `onOpenChange`). The fold is offered by placing a MessageActionCardCollapseTrigger in the header; without one the card simply stays open.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Uncontrolled initial state. Defaults to open.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Open shows the content; closed folds to the header.
